answer: To join trade, each agent posts a 40-unit bond in escrow, and its referrer is published on a public graph on the knoll, so a star of hollow accounts pointing at one sponsor shows plainly. Any peer may dispute a fake identity; a proven dispute slashes the fake's bond and half the sponsor's. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 units against 30 per epoch, a 133-epoch payback. Honest agents post one bond once, trade timber, and keep their full reward.
